lyrics.text: Pehle nahi thi aisi, meri zindagi koi
Tere aane se mujhe, mili hai khushi koi
Aankhon mein aankhein daal ke jab
Tu mujhe dekhe, dil mera dhadke
Dehleez pe mere dil ki, jo rakhe hain tune kadam
Tere naam pe meri zindagi, likh di mere sanam
Haan seekha maine jeena jeena jaise jeena
Haan seekha maine jeena tumse hi seekha
Khwabon mein aake tu jo mujhe
Jagaaye, phir so nahi paata hoon main
Dehleez pe mere dil ki, jo rakhe hain tune kadam
Tere naam pe meri zindagi, likh di mere sanam
Haan seekha maine jeena jeena jaise jeena
Haan seekha maine jeena tumse hi seekha
